observed_failure: The original two-second response read timed out; the entire test elapsed 5.499 seconds. Those are different measurements.
source_proven_cause: The existing fixture requests blocked.example. NetworkProxyState::host_blocked checks explicit deny, then DNS/private-IP classification, then allowlist. Its DNS_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT is two seconds, equal to this fixture read timeout. On a slow resolver the HTTP denial cannot arrive before the test deadline. The fixture unintentionally depends on ambient DNS although it is meant to exercise executor-local proxy configuration and non-allowlisted request rejection.
actual_run_limit: No per-request DNS duration or traced response path was captured in the failed run. Slow DNS is a source-supported explanation of this timeout, not a newly measured host finding. No DNS, HTTP or other external-network probe was run for this repair.
existing_reference: The same runtime.rs host_blocked_requires_allowlist_match test already uses public IP literal 8.8.8.8, with an explicit comment avoiding ambient DNS.
repair: Change both CONNECT target and Host header to the same existing public IP literal, 8.8.8.8:443; add an explanatory fixture comment. The allowed_domains entry remains allowed.example.
why_no_external_dial: With the original config, 8.8.8.8 is not allowlisted. The private-IP helper classifies IP literals without invoking lookup, then host_blocked returns NotAllowed. HTTP CONNECT rejection occurs before any upstream tunnel dial. No production policy order was changed.
source_api_or_wire_change: No production or public source API change; only test input bytes and fixture comment changed.
